name: registry
description: Register this researcher's own Task Agent and its running instance in the central registry, and check the service's health.
notes: The registry authorizes by caller_type, not by the domain capability tiers, so this card claims no capabilities. Its token identity must be caller_type=researcher holding this researcher's principal_id; registration of an instance then passes only for an agent whose principal_id is that researcher, and register_workflow_agent passes only for kind=endpoint.

get_agent_registration and get_principal_contact are absent because the service refuses them to a researcher (project_owner, or a service token with role centre/email). Listing them would advertise calls that always fail.
The registry does not decide whether a TaskNode may execute; the formal mapping's executor_refs does.

tools.name: register_workflow_agent
tools.description: Register or update a workflow agent owned by the caller or Project Owner.
allowed: declaring this researcher's Task Agent before its first handoff

tools.name: register_agent_instance
tools.description: Register or refresh one runtime instance of a workflow agent.
allowed: marking the local subscriber online so the coordinator may deliver to it

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return authenticated Registry service and storage health.
allowed: checking the registry before blaming a delivery failure on the queue
